item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Warmer Colours Only

turns.text: Make it warmer—just the colours, please. Don't change anything in the picture.

item.tests: Tests interpreting 'warmer' as a colour-temperature adjustment rather than a scene or weather change.

answer_sheet.Meaning of warmer: A warmer colour balance only, not different weather, a new sunset or added objects.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 composition; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Text or other edits: No text and no changes beyond the colours.

must_haves: The image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the source.
The same mountains, pine trees, clouds and lake remain in their original positions.
The lake's reflections and surface details retain their original structure.
No sun, sunset, extra clouds or other scene elements are added.
Framing, geometry and image detail remain unchanged apart from colour.

turns.text: Make this pic warmer—just the colours, please. Don't change anything else in the picture. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it'll cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest Magic Hour option is **one 640px image edit with Flux 2 Klein, starting at 5 credits**. It’s available on your free plan. **I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.**

- **Smaller/cheaper:** 640px is the smallest supported setting; one image is the lowest-cost option.
- **Shorter:** Not applicable to a still photo.
- **Important:** AI editing can subtly change details, even when asked to change only colours, so I can’t guarantee everything else stays identical.

For your “don’t change anything else” requirement, a **free, non-AI photo editor’s Warmth/Temperature slider** is the better choice: it changes colours without regenerating the scene and uses no Magic Hour credits.

Would you prefer instructions for that free option, or proceed with the AI edit starting at 5 credits?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that free option—please give me the instructions for changing only the warmth without altering anything else.

turns.agent:
Use a **non-AI photo editor**, such as your phone’s built-in Photos app. This costs **no Magic Hour credits**.

1. Open **lake.jpg** and select **Edit**.
2. Find **Warmth** or **Temperature** under the colour adjustments.
3. Move that slider slightly toward **warm/yellow**. Start around **+5 to +10** if the scale runs from −100 to +100.
4. Leave every other control unchanged—especially filters, Auto Enhance, crop, exposure, and saturation.
5. Compare with the original. For this lake photo, aim for a gentle golden tint while keeping the snow and clouds looking natural.
6. Choose **Save a copy** or **Export** so you retain the original. Keep the original dimensions and use the highest quality available.

**For the least file alteration:** export as PNG if supported; saving as JPEG can introduce slight compression changes. Only the warmth adjustment is needed—no AI tools or regeneration.
